items.en_title: Carazinho (RS) Works & infrastructure procurement · electronic pregão (reverse auction) · closes Nov 25 #PCE 14
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Carazinho (RS) is procuring works, repairs or infrastructure services through electronic pregão (reverse auction); proposals close Nov 25, 08:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
